tasks.short: Sketch or draw actual objects to be crafted.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual object references, chosen materials, dimensions and relevant earlier craft sketches
inputs: actual intended craft object and materials
actual owned/reference drawings and dimension requirements

steps.what: Sketch or draw actual objects, exploring form, construction, proportion and craft details
inputs: checked actual object reference context
actual artist ideas and chosen craft approach

steps.what: Check actual final sketch against intended form, dimensions, material and construction feasibility
inputs: actual artist-created object sketch
checked actual object reference context

steps.what: Save checked final actual object sketch where a digital record is used
inputs: checked final actual object sketch

tasks.design: Configure native object/material reference links in {DOCS}. Retain actual sketching and full form/construction checking, with a separate save only where a digital sketch record is actually used.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sketch preparation can repeat navigation to actual reference drawings and dimensions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Handcrafted form and workable construction require artistic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The artist recognises a pleasing drawing that cannot be made in the chosen material.
tasks.altitude: Less reference lookup; artistic drawing stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native drawing/reference links can assist sketch preparation; they do not create a craft artist's intended form or prove makeability.

assumptions: Actual artist/client/reference owners supply intended dimensions/materials and permitted references; artist checks them. S2 retains every actual artistic stroke/choice; no image generation, material testing or craft work is assumed free.

Digital reference/save branch applies only where actually used; paper-only sketching removes/reweights it and may yield zero after any actual lookup is examined. No mandatory scan or report is invented. Actual client delivery, if required, is separately final-sketch gated with no avoided time claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking.
unknowns: Does actual sketch preparation repeat digital reference lookup?
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval while retaining all artistic sketching?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual object sketch and exact artist-record destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 reference navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Actual drawing, feasibility checking and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop packaging, display and pricing strategies for craft products.

steps.what: Develop actual packaging and display concepts suited to product protection, presentation and customers
inputs: actual craft objects and selling context
actual material/protection/display constraints
outputs: actual chosen packaging/display options and required quantities

steps.what: Calculate actual product, packaging, display and channel costs from verified prices and artist measurements
inputs: actual chosen packaging/display options and required quantities
actual supplier prices, measured labour/material use and channel fees
outputs: checked actual cost scenarios with unresolved inputs

steps.what: Choose actual product packaging, display and pricing strategies using cost and market judgement
inputs: checked actual cost scenarios with unresolved inputs
actual customer feedback and artistic/business objectives

steps.what: Record and check final strategy and intended customer price against actual costs and terms
inputs: actual chosen packaging/display/pricing strategy
checked actual cost scenarios with unresolved inputs
outputs: checked final strategy and exact intended product price/channel

steps.what: Save checked final packaging/display/pricing strategy record
inputs: checked final strategy and exact intended product price/channel

steps.what: Publish exact checked product price through actual intended selling channel
inputs: checked final strategy and exact intended product price/channel

tasks.design: Configure fixed cost/price formulas in {SPREADSHEET} using actual measured inputs and verified source terms in {DOCS}. Retain packaging/display design and pricing choices, with complete final strategy checking before separate save and actual price publication in {ECOMMERCE}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cost scenarios may repeat manual arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated fixed formulas can calculate from actual quantities and source prices.
tasks.still_hard: A viable artistic product needs suitable presentation and market judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The artist judges whether a price or presentation fits the work's actual audience.
tasks.altitude: Less cost arithmetic; artistic strategy stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed cost formulas can support craft pricing scenarios; they do not measure actual making time, predict demand or choose an appropriate selling price.

assumptions: Actual supplier/channel owners produce prices/fees; artist measures actual material use and labour, retained in s1/s2. Missing inputs stay unresolved rather than invented baselines. S2 cuts repeated arithmetic only while retaining input collection/verification.

S3 retains every strategy choice; s4 retains new strategy capture and complete source/terms checking. Actual digital price publication only where used; strategy-only work removes/reweights publication. No automatic purchases, discount campaign or physical packaging work proposed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Existing spreadsheet formulas/runtime earn zero new saving. Save/publication each retain one percent using existing checking.
unknowns: Which actual cost arithmetic remains manual?
research_questions: Can fixed formulas reduce arithmetic after complete measured-input checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual cost formulas and source-price/fee versions.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual strategy and exact record destination; edits require recheck
s4 exact final product price, terms and intended product/channel destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.50 repeated cost arithmetic = 12.5; minus 1 upkeep = 11.5. Half eligible gives 6.25 minus 1 = 5.25. Actual input measurement, design, strategy, final checking and save/publication retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with customers about needs and feedback.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual customer commission, product details and prior permitted feedback
inputs: actual customer enquiry or commission
actual product/commission records and permitted feedback

steps.what: Confer with actual customers to assess needs and obtain craft-product feedback
inputs: checked actual customer/product context
actual customer explanation, preferences and feedback
outputs: actual clarified needs and chosen follow-up

steps.what: Record and check actual customer requirements, feedback and agreed follow-up where written confirmation is required
inputs: actual clarified needs and chosen follow-up
outputs: checked final actual customer note/confirmation and intended recipient

steps.what: Save checked actual customer needs/feedback record
inputs: checked final actual customer note/confirmation and intended recipient

steps.what: Send exact checked customer confirmation through actual permitted communication channel
inputs: checked final actual customer note/confirmation and intended recipient
outputs: actual chosen requirements/follow-up confirmed to customer

tasks.design: Configure native customer/product links in {CRM} and {DOCS}. Retain actual needs discussion and new feedback capture/check before separate record save and any actual written confirmation through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customer conversations can repeat commission/product lookup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native customer/product links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Actual tastes, needs and feedback require discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The artist interprets a customer's concern that cannot be expressed as a standard product option.
tasks.altitude: Less customer lookup; discussion stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native customer/product links can support preparation; they do not assess unexpressed customer needs.

assumptions: Actual customer and commission owners supply context; all new needs/feedback are produced during retained s2 and captured/checked in s3. No preference inferred from browsing.
Written record/confirmation only where actual; informal oral exchange removes unused branches and reweights. No mandatory transcript/report invented. Shared show feedback counted once.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checking.
research_questions: Can native links reduce navigation while preserving actual needs discussion?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual customer record and exact destination; edits require recheck
s3 exact final actual confirmation and intended customer; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Actual conversation, new record capture/check and save/send retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and attend craft shows to market products.

steps.what: Find and check actual craft-show audience, dates, space requirements, fees and participation terms
inputs: actual craft products and show opportunities
actual organiser information and participation terms

steps.what: Choose actual show, products, display approach, staffing, transport and participation budget
inputs: checked actual craft-show options
actual stock and artist availability/resources
outputs: actual chosen craft-show plan and application decisions

steps.what: Prepare actual show application, product list and planning checklist using verified artist/product fields
inputs: actual chosen craft-show plan and application decisions
actual artist/product records and organiser fields
outputs: complete actual show application and planning draft

steps.what: Check exact final application, products, terms, fees, dates and actual organiser destination
inputs: complete actual show application and planning draft
checked actual craft-show options
outputs: checked final actual application/plan and organiser destination

steps.what: Submit exact checked craft-show application to actual organiser
inputs: checked final actual application/plan and organiser destination
outputs: actual application submitted; organiser acceptance remains pending

steps.what: Prepare physical stock/display, attend actual accepted craft show and market products to visitors
inputs: actual accepted participation and chosen show plan
actual craft stock, display equipment and visitors
outputs: actual show participation and observed customer feedback/results

steps.what: Record and check actual show results and chosen follow-up where required
inputs: actual show participation and observed customer feedback/results

steps.what: Save checked actual craft-show results record
inputs: checked final actual show-result record

tasks.design: Configure native show/source links in {DOCS} and {CALENDAR}, with repeated artist/product application fields in {PARTNER_PORTAL}. Retain actual planning and full application checking before separate submission, then physical preparation/attendance and actual result capture/check before separate save in {DOCS} or {CRM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Show planning can repeat organiser-source navigation and artist/product entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and application fields can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Suitable shows and effective visitor interaction require artist judgement and presence.
tasks.human_edge: The artist learns which work interests actual show visitors.
tasks.altitude: Less show administration; physical attendance stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native event links and artist/product fields can assist show planning; they do not secure acceptance, prepare physical stock or market products in person.

assumptions: Actual organisers supply terms/dates; actual artist/product records supply stable fields. Artist verifies sources and chooses actual plan in s2. S3 cuts repeated fields only, retaining new plan content and full checking.

S6 occurs only after actual acceptance, not inferred from submission. All physical preparation, travel, display and visitor work remain. Actual sales/payment records or fee payment, if present, are distinct exact-final-terms gated transactions with no avoided labour claimed here.

Actual post-show record only where required; omit unused branches and reweight for actual show route. Shares are provisional, not measured. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero saving. Send/save each retain one percent using existing checks; shared customer feedback counted once.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce planning administration after complete term checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual show/source and artist/product field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact checked final show application, terms/fees and intended organiser; edits void approval
s7 checked final actual show-result record and exact destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 source lookup + 20*0.30 repeated application fields = 12; minus 1 upkeep = 11. Half eligible gives 6 minus 1 = 5. Actual plan, final checking, submission, physical preparation/attendance and result capture/save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Craft artists retain artistic and customer judgement while actual reference lookup, cost arithmetic and repeated application fields may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated administration without reducing artistic making, physical shows or customer discussion.
